actions.action: Preserve original highlights as immutable records
actions.mechanism: Separate the original evidence from revision-specific placements so deleted text remains available with its notes.
actions.implementation: Store highlighted text, revision ID, original range, and surrounding context; retain that revision. Record subsequent placements separately.
actions.check: Delete a highlighted paragraph; verify its note still opens the original passage and reports no current placement.
actions.risk: Retaining revisions increases storage and requires explicit retention policies.

actions.action: Track passage identity through edits and moves
actions.mechanism: Persistent block IDs and recorded edit operations distinguish moved content from identical text elsewhere.
actions.implementation: Preserve IDs on moves, assign new IDs on copies, and map ranges through edit operations. Automatically retain only verified unchanged selections.
actions.check: Move a paragraph containing a repeated sentence; verify its note follows the original block with a visible operation trail.
actions.risk: Imported revisions may lack identity evidence; changed selections require review.

actions.action: Offer comparison without assuming a match
actions.mechanism: Candidate discovery stays separate from attachment; repetition and meaning-changing edits produce explicit review states.
actions.implementation: For unverified placements, list exact and approximate candidates with section context. Show original/new diffs; require confirmation or allow unresolved status.
actions.check: Test identical repeated sentences and an inserted “not”; neither may silently acquire the note, and both must support comparison.
actions.risk: Candidate ranking can bias choices; show alternatives and permit rejection.

actions.action: Limit placement decisions to explicit revisions
actions.mechanism: Revision-scoped decisions prevent one manual reassignment from silently governing later or branched document versions.
actions.implementation: Record each accepted placement with source revision, target revision, evidence, and actor. Revalidate subsequent revisions rather than copying accepted status.
actions.check: Confirm a placement in revision two, then alter its meaning in revision three; verify review resumes and revision two remains unchanged.
actions.risk: Frequent edits may create repeated review work.
